{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (sentinel)
df = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Convert batch B biomarker_final from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df.loc[df["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final"] /= 10

# Step 3: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is numeric and sort by it
df["sample_seq"] = pd.to_numeric(df["sample_seq"])
df = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])

# Keep only the first (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Check final shape
print(f'Final number of patients: {len(df)}')

# Check for any remaining sentinel values in biomarker_final
print(f'Remaining -999 in biomarker_final: {(df["biomarker_final"] == -999).sum()}')

# Compute change in biomarker
df["change"] = df["biomarker_final"] - df["biomarker_baseline"]

# Compute average change
avg_change = df["change"].mean()

# Output
print(f'Average biomarker change (ng/mL): {avg_change}')"}
